Title: Integrity Agreement and Research Interests
Requirement: Sign the integrity and AI-disclosure agreement; identify three feasible issue areas.

Title: Preliminary Question and Scope
Requirement: Submit a focused question, cases, time period, concepts, and exclusions.

Title: Source Map and Annotated Bibliography I
Requirement: Submit at least eight credible sources, including primary or authoritative records.

Title: Comparative Framework and Feasibility Review
Requirement: Defend case selection, variables, access to evidence, ethics, and schedule.

Title: Formal Proposal Defense
Requirement: Pass the proposal defense and complete all required revisions.

Title: Methods and Evidence Collection Audit
Requirement: Submit methods, evidence log, source evaluation, and data-management plan.

Title: Annotated Bibliography II and Preliminary Analysis
Requirement: Show a mature evidence base, coding or calculations, and competing explanations.

Title: Findings Conference and Integrity Audit
Requirement: Present preliminary findings, negative evidence, limitations, and disclosure record.

Title: Complete Draft and Revision Memo
Requirement: Submit the full paper, peer review, citation audit, and revision plan.

Title: Final Thesis, Defense, and Portfolio Audit
Requirement: Submit final artifacts and pass the oral defense and graduation audit.
